published_pr.note: PR includes the approved NTT pass only. SHA changes remain local.

methodology: Two sequential paired samples per variant/entry point with no concurrent builds or validation jobs. Saved NTT binaries reused. Dispatch diagnostics overlapped native checks and are excluded from runtime comparison. Rejection suites ran concurrently only after profiling.

hashlib.note: Raw compression/transcript bytes require the separate guest comparison.

vectors.scope: 301 independent hashlib digest comparisons; full native/guest equality includes 24 raw-compression cases and 11 transcript sequences. No formal equivalence proof.

limitations: Two performance samples; host-executor RSS only.
